strings.SS2_NEMCROCO_OUTRO_FLAVOR: ..and so he left, fading into the unknown.
strings.SS2_NEMCROCO_OUTRO_FAILURE: ..and so he returned, legacy lost forever.
strings.SS2_KEYWORD_RADIATION: <style=cKeywordName>Radiation</style><style=cSub>Applies radiation equal to <style=cIsDamage>200%</style> TOTAL damage to the end of the health bar, over 5s.
strings.SS2_KEYWORD_DAMAGESHARE: <style=cKeywordName>something that isnt radiation</style><style=cSub>Something'd enemies share 50% of damage with another nearby enemy.
strings.SS2_NEMCROCO_PASSIVE_DESCRIPTION: Poisonous skills deal radiation damage over time. Radiation is applied to the end of the health bar.
strings.SS2_NEMCROCO_PRIMARY_DESCRIPTION: Maul an enemy for 240% damage, plus 240% damage over time. Fully irradiated enemies are instantly killed and grant Regenerative.
strings.SS2_NEMCROCO_SECONDARY_DESCRIPTION: Poisonous. Fire a toxic beam for 300% damage over time, then fire a larger blast for 200% damage.
strings.SS2_NEMCROCO_UTILITY_DESCRIPTION: Poisonous. Dive into the ground and leave a trail of acid for 150% damage per second. Then, breach for 300% damage.
strings.SS2_NEMCROCO_SPECIAL_DESCRIPTION: Poisonous. Release a blob of toxic bile that deals 300% damage and Somethings enemies, making them share damage taken.
